service.name: Aeturna (Mount)
service.longDescription: The eternal sentinel of Eureka Orthos — Aeturna answers only to those who master its hundred floors. Guaranteed with four full clears, piloted or alongside our raiders in group play.

rewards.title: Group Play or Piloted
rewards.text: Cleared by a veteran raider on your account, or alongside our team on your own character.

rewards.title: Savage Loot Along the Way
rewards.text: Gear coffers, totems and glamours from every clear.

accordion.title: Requirements
items: Duty unlocked (available as an additional service)
